task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL. For example, 'https://my-bucket.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' should return 'us-west-2'.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing a user to read and list objects from a specific S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'.
Write a regular expression that validates an AWS access key ID format. AWS access keys start with 'AKIA' followed by 16 alphanumeric characters (e.g., 'AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE').
